<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>body{margin:0}</style></head><body><svg width="1080" height="600" viewBox="0 0 1080 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<rect width="1080" height="600" fill="#eef4fb"/>
<rect y="440" width="1080" height="160" fill="#dbe7f5"/>
<!-- window skyline -->
<rect x="60" y="70" width="420" height="250" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#bcd2ea" stroke-width="4"/>
<g fill="#9db8d6">
<rect x="90" y="150" width="34" height="130"/><rect x="132" y="120" width="34" height="160"/><rect x="174" y="170" width="34" height="110"/><rect x="216" y="100" width="34" height="180"/><rect x="258" y="140" width="34" height="140"/><rect x="300" y="180" width="34" height="100"/><rect x="342" y="130" width="34" height="150"/><rect x="384" y="160" width="34" height="120"/>
</g>
<circle cx="420" cy="105" r="22" fill="#ffd66b"/>
<!-- desk -->
<rect x="520" y="330" width="480" height="26" rx="8" fill="#3e5e82"/>
<rect x="545" y="356" width="24" height="180" fill="#35506f"/>
<rect x="950" y="356" width="24" height="180" fill="#35506f"/>
<!-- chair -->
<rect x="700" y="240" width="120" height="16" rx="8" fill="#2f4a68"/>
<rect x="700" y="240" width="120" height="140" rx="18" fill="#2f4a68" opacity="0.25"/>
<!-- robot -->
<g>
<rect x="712" y="230" width="96" height="90" rx="22" fill="#5b8fd6"/>
<rect x="724" y="246" width="72" height="46" rx="14" fill="#0f2440"/>
<circle cx="744" cy="269" r="8" fill="#7fe0ff"/>
<circle cx="776" cy="269" r="8" fill="#7fe0ff"/>
<rect x="746" y="288" width="28" height="6" rx="3" fill="#7fe0ff"/>
<rect x="748" y="212" width="24" height="14" rx="6" fill="#3e6aa8"/>
<circle cx="760" cy="206" r="7" fill="#ff8f5e"/>
<rect x="700" y="300" width="120" height="80" rx="20" fill="#4d7ec2"/>
<rect x="660" y="310" width="46" height="20" rx="10" fill="#3e6aa8" transform="rotate(-25 683 320)"/>
<rect x="814" y="310" width="46" height="20" rx="10" fill="#3e6aa8" transform="rotate(25 837 320)"/>
<!-- tie -->
<polygon points="760,306 748,320 760,372 772,320" fill="#e05656"/>
</g>
<!-- documents on desk -->
<g>
<rect x="560" y="306" width="70" height="24" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#a9c2de" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(-8 595 318)"/>
<rect x="640" y="302" width="70" height="28" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#a9c2de" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="860" y="300" width="80" height="30" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#a9c2de" stroke-width="3"/>
<polyline points="872,320 886,308 898,314 912,300 928,306" stroke="#e05656" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
</g>
<!-- big question mark -->
<g font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC" font-weight="bold">
<text x="200" y="430" font-size="150" fill="#5b8fd6" opacity="0.85">?</text>
</g>
<text x="540" y="520" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC" font-size="52" font-weight="bold" fill="#1c3a5e">AI 当 CEO，能成功吗？</text>
<text x="540" y="565" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC" font-size="24" fill="#5b7ba0">权力 · 边界 · 信任</text>
</svg></body></html>

content.text: 图像生成接口返回 404（`/v1/images/generations` 不可用）。我改用本机真实渲染路径：手绘 SVG 扁平插画并用 Playwright Chromium 截图成 PNG，保证真实产出图片文件。
